Top 4 Indian Restaurants in Da Nang 🇻🇳 | Maazi vs Maharaja vs Indus vs Vanda Buffet 🍛 Which Is Best?
🍛 Which is the BEST Indian restaurant in Da Nang, Vietnam? In this video, I compare the **Top 4 Indian Restaurants in Da Nang** – **Maazi, Maharaja, Indus Restaurant & Vanda Buffet**! 🇻🇳

I reviewed:
✅ Food taste & quality
✅ Price & value for money

✅ Buffet variety
✅ Best dishes to try
